Our Story

Our family has served your family since 1967.

It started with a push cart on the streets of New York City. Giovanni Romano's grandson, Neil, brought his mother's Manhattan-kitchen recipes to Littleton and opened Romano's with his wife, Ellie, in 1967. Three generations later, we're still cooking the same sauce, from scratch, every single day.

Read the full story

We honor the standards of dedication and hard work set by our family, who settled in America in the early 1900s — fearless young Italians who boarded a boat in search of La Dolce Vita. Nearly 100 years later, we're proud to carry that legacy forward, serving Littleton families with the same care Giovanni put into every plate off his cart. Generations of local families have shared a meal and a conversation right here on Windermere Street. Raise a glass with us. Salute! And mangia, mangia!
